headline: 澳洲原住民時尚週登場
context: 澳洲多位原住民設計師、模特兒與藝術家齊聚達爾文（Darwin）的拉拉基亞地（Larrakia Country），參加「Country to Couture」時裝秀與全國原住民時尚獎。這場活動把文化與氣候議題交織進服裝設計裡。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: First Nations designers, models, artists and artisans from across Australia gathered on Larrakia Country in Darwin this week for the Country to Couture runway show and the National Indigenous Fashion awards. In between, Guardian Australia photographed several of the featured models and designers Delvene Cockatoo-Collins wins National Indigenous Fashion award for textiles harvested on Country First Nations fashion celebrates weaving, wattle and waterways at Country to Couture 2026 – in pictures Models CJ Rankin, a Kiyak woman, and Nelson Baker Bardi, a Nyikina man, wear Nagula Jarndu Designs. The art centre Nagula Jarndu (Saltwater Woman) began in Rubibi/Broome in 1987 as a place for Yawuru women to gather, preserve language, share knowledge and keep culture strong. Their hand-carved woodblock prints on cotton and silks, shown at Country to Couture, share stories of saltwater, plants, family and Country. Continue reading...

澳洲多位原住民設計師、模特兒與藝術家齊聚達爾文（Darwin）的拉拉基亞地（Larrakia Country），參加「Country to Couture」時裝秀與全國原住民時尚獎，這場活動把文化與氣候議題一起織進了服裝設計裡。

voice_text: 澳洲有一場原住民時尚週，在達爾文的拉拉基亞地登場。多位原住民設計師、模特兒與藝術家齊聚一堂，參加時裝秀和全國原住民時尚獎。這場活動，把文化跟氣候議題一起織進了服裝設計裡。
